title: Layout Defect Catalog Explorer
description: A deliberately flawed mock MicroSim with eight layout defects in three families: clipped content (cut-off row labels, a title under a side panel, a painted-over legend heading), hidden controls (a slider past the right edge, a slider label over its track, overlapping buttons) and color contrast (black-haloed text, pale text on aliceblue). Clicking a region flags it; correct flags open a card with the checklist item, cause and repair, and Apply repair redraws the mock.
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Educational Technology
Quality Assurance
Visual Design
MicroSim Engineering

educational.audience: Teachers, instructional designers, learning-technology developers and learning-analytics practitioners
educational.topic: Layout defects and the visual checklist
learningObjectives: The learner will distinguish clipped content, hidden controls and low color contrast in a rendered MicroSim, and will match each defect to its checklist item and its usual repair.
prerequisites: The standard MicroSim layout: aliceblue drawing region, white control region (Chapter 2)
Layout defects and the fixes table (Chapter 13)

accessibility.notes: describe() provides a screen-reader description; all controls are native HTML elements.

assumptions: Each defect has one bounding box in the mock; clicks inside it count as a correct flag.
limitations: Only eight defects from checklist sections 1 to 3 are seeded; sections 4 to 6 have none.

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Search and classify with immediate feedback
keyQuestions: Which family does this defect belong to?
What in the code most likely caused it?
commonMisconceptions: A layout that runs without errors has no defects.
Clipped text is always at the bottom of the iframe.
Contrast problems are only about color choice, never about leftover strokes.
assessmentOpportunities: The learner finds at least six of the eight defects without Reveal.
The learner sorts each defect into clipped content, hidden control or color contrast and names its checklist item.
